_comment: The other half of the app: a config. This one and read-only.json differ in a single word, and that word is `access`.
_caps: The ceiling. Nothing in this process, now or later, is outside it. `host:fs/*` covers all four verbs; it does not decide which of them the connector answers.
_connectors: A connector is wired to a PLACE. The directory is a machine fact and belongs here; the filenames are an application detail and belong in the program, so this file never carries one.
